changesets.name: bulk-write-announcements.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/effect-sql": minor
"@shivaedev/effect-contract": minor
---

### Breaking

- effect-sql writes returning more than 1,000 rows across all chunks of a single call announce `<table>` and `<table>:*` instead of item keys. Code registering raw `<table>:<id>` Reactivity keys outside effect-contract must also register `<table>:*`.

### Added

- effect-contract item reads refresh on their collection-wide `<collection>:*` key, with live hints naming each affected subscribed item.

changesets.name: factory-story-kits.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/quality": patch
---

### Fixed

- Recognize story kits returned by local or imported factory functions, including kits extended through object spreads, while still reporting plain test registrations beside them.

changesets.name: migration-wait-signal.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/effect-sql": minor
"@shivaedev/platform": minor
"@shivaedev/create-app": patch
---

### Added

- `@shivaedev/effect-sql` exports `pendingPostgresMigrations` to read pending ledger migration IDs and names and schema component names and details.
- `@shivaedev/platform` logs migration wait start, periodic progress, completion and timeout through Effect's logger with pending migration and component annotations. `migrations.progressInterval` controls progress logging independently of polling and defaults to 30 seconds.

### Changed

- `@shivaedev/create-app`'s starter worker uses the host's migration wait logs and keeps its job readiness line.

changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/create-app": minor

### Added

- Generate the starter foundation without the notes example with `create-app <folder> --minimal`; starter updates preserve the minimal choice.

changesets.name: outbound-http-client.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/platform": minor
---

### Added

- Outbound HTTP client status errors, clock-based Retry-After parsing, lazy same-origin Link pagination, and bounded bytes, text and Schema-decoded JSON response readers.

"@shivaedev/platform": minor

### Added

- Let `signedInUser` create provider accounts without credentials and expose `storedProviderAccounts` to read account IDs and credential-presence booleans without returning secret values.
